sources.title: Log Analytics workspace resource reference: 2023-09-01
sources.note: Stable ARM schema for the dedicated workspace, retention, quota and authentication settings. Local compilation does not confirm Azure quota or billing.

sources.title: Application Insights component resource reference: 2020-02-02
sources.note: Stable ARM schema for a workspace-based component and local authentication settings. This is Azure observability, not proof of Agent 365 integration.

sources.title: Microsoft Sentinel onboarding state resource reference: 2024-03-01
sources.note: Stable workspace-scoped onboarding resource. The schema does not support ownership tags. Onboarding alone does not deploy connectors or analytic rules.

sources.title: Azure AI Services account resource reference: 2024-10-01
sources.note: Stable account schema for OpenAI kind, Entra-only authentication, custom subdomain and network ACLs. The lab uses default deny with explicit IPv4 approvals.

sources.title: Azure OpenAI model deployment resource reference: 2024-10-01
sources.note: Stable child-resource schema for tags, model name, model version, SKU, capacity and version upgrade behavior. The operator must verify regional availability and quota separately.

sources.title: Azure built-in role: Cognitive Services OpenAI User
sources.note: Role reference for account-scoped model use. The lab assigns it only to an explicitly supplied human operator object ID. It does not create or represent an Entra Agent ID.
